messages:
ava: quick sync  finalizing announcement flow for next release. need canonical changelog + docs permalink + rollout window for the blog and webinar CTAs.
leo: target deploy: 2026-06-10 13:00 UTC canary, 13:20 full. no infra conflicts.
harper: webinar at 14:00 UTC. marketing wants docs link by 13:15 so slides and demo links match.
leo: changelog below  please use verbatim in post header and docs summary:
```
RWD-Infer v2.6.0 (2026-06-10)
- Adaptive KV cache improvements for multi-tenant workloads
- New INT8 kernels for T4 and A10x (cost and latency improvements)
- Batching scheduler enhancements: better tail behavior under mixed traffic
- Stream resume stability fixes and misc reliability patches
```
ava: nice. can we publish a simple rollback line for the announcement (marketing-friendly)?
leo: publish: "Automatic fallback to rwd-infer-2.5.x with automated traffic cutover (minutes)". ops will run probes.
ops-oncall: will run health probes at t+0 and t+5m; posting status to #eng-oncall. tagging deploy hooks.
docs-bot: preview published at https://docs.redwood.ai/release/preview/2-6-0. final permalink will be https://docs.redwood.ai/releases/rwd-infer-2.6.0 when live.
ava: inbound lead routing: SDR wants registrants flagged release-june10 and routed to SDR-D. sdr-bot, confirm webhook fields?
sdr-bot: set campaign=release-june10, source=announce-page, tag=release-june10. assigning to SDR-D. pushing mapping to #integrations.
harper: marketing blurb: "up to 20% cost savings with new int8 kernels". eng prefers: "up to 20% per-token cost improvement on our internal mixed workload benchmark."
ava: we'll use the up-to phrasing. final checklist: leo confirm deploy times (done); docs-bot publish permalink (pending); sdr-bot mapping (in progress); ops-oncall probes (pending); ava send final announcement T-10m.
leo: posting canary note to #deploy-1861234599-canary at T-30 and bump at T-5. good to go from infra.
ava: thanks all. scheduling 12:30 UTC preflight call for last checks. ping if anything changes. :rocket:
